key_decisions.rationale: Follows the pinned additional beast clause and preserves repeated fallen and haunt.
key_decisions.before: And he called out with a mighty voice, “Fallen, fallen is Babylon the great! She has become a dwelling place for demons, a haunt for every unclean spirit, a haunt for every unclean bird, a haunt for every unclean and detestable beast.
key_decisions.after: He cried out in a mighty voice: “Fallen, fallen is Babylon the great! She has become a dwelling for demons, a haunt of every unclean spirit, a haunt of every unclean bird, and a haunt of every unclean and hated beast.

key_decisions.rationale: Follows the pinned have fallen rather than have drunk and keeps rulers, merchants and luxury distinct.
key_decisions.before: For all nations have drunk the wine of the passion of her immorality, and the kings of the earth have committed immorality with her, and the merchants of the earth have grown rich from the power of her luxury.”
key_decisions.after: For all the nations have fallen through the wine of the passion of her prostitution. The kings of the earth committed sexual immorality with her, and the merchants of the earth grew rich from the power of her luxury.”
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: For all nations have drunk the wine of the passion of her immorality, and the kings of the earth have committed immorality with her, and the merchants of the earth have grown rich from the power of her luxury.”

key_decisions.rationale: Retains the full list's final commodification of human bodies and lives instead of hiding it in a generic goods term.
key_decisions.before: cinnamon, spice, incense, myrrh, frankincense, wine, oil, fine flour, wheat, cattle and sheep, horses and chariots, and slaves—that is, human lives.
key_decisions.after: cinnamon and spice, incense, perfume and frankincense; wine, oil, fine flour and wheat; cattle and sheep; horses and carriages; and bodies—human lives.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: cinnamon, spice, incense, myrrh, frankincense, wine, oil, fine flour, wheat, cattle and sheep, horses and chariots, and slaves—that is, human lives.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps the shift to direct address and the pinned third-person find rather than harmonizing it to you.
